allowed_after_raw_vector_reveal: Pareto relation on structural-cost coordinates conditional on Q0=Q1=1
initial-vs-follow-up sign reversal or no-reversal classification
reversal_definition: A reversal requires the direction of DIRECT minus INVERT to change sign between phase 0 and phase 1 on at least one homologous structural-cost coordinate, with both arms valid in both phases.
pareto_rule: One arm may be called locally Pareto-dominant only if it is no worse on every authorized cost coordinate and strictly better on at least one, with Q0=Q1=1 for both arms.
founding_return: A result is useful only as one conditional-law witness toward identifying when inversion helps, hurts, reverses or warrants abstention.
